subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support an accessible Volta shim as the fallback LaunchAgent Node executable when no supported system Node is available?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes the managed-service runtime policy in an area where current docs and audit checks intentionally warn against version-manager Node paths.

options.title: Support narrow Volta fallback
options.body: Keep supported system Node first, then normalize Volta tools/image Node paths to an accessible Volta shim with regression tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof.

options.title: Keep system Node only
options.body: Reject the Volta fallback and document that managed gateway services should use a supported system/Homebrew Node to clear the warning.

options.title: Defer to broader runtime pin policy
options.body: Route the Volta request into the broader version-manager runtime-pin decision tracked by the related warning issue instead of landing a Volta-specific fallback first.

recommendation.title: Support narrow Volta fallback
recommendation.body: Keep supported system Node first, then normalize Volta tools/image Node paths to an accessible Volta shim with regression tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current system-Node preference and Homebrew stable-path precedent both route through this maintainer’s runtime-selection history.
